tmac.headline: Getting an AI demo to work is one thing. Getting it to run inside a real company is another.
tmac.summary: Production pipeline deployed on the client's own servers: Outlook to Graph API to PostgreSQL to LLM to a NetSuite Suitelet. Now live and in hypercare.

tmac.headline: “This could save us a lot of money.”
tmac.summary: The CEO's reaction as the system caught a real order error live. The demo turned into a talk about more AI projects, including a RAG chatbot.

tmac.headline: Up to one in five orders carried a discrepancy.
tmac.summary: A seven-layer pipeline reads the rep–customer thread, works out what was agreed, checks it against the ERP and flags mismatches by severity. It flags; a person decides.

tmac.headline: In manufacturing, a single wrong number on an order can cost thousands.
tmac.summary: Delivered the prototype pitch to a Houston fiberglass manufacturer. Next phase: NetSuite integration via MCP.

hpe.headline: Delivered the ReVolve presentation to HPE leadership.
hpe.summary: 8 stations, live 3D visualisation, SimPy simulation and an on-device LLM for what-if analysis, plus a great lunch conversation after.

hpe.headline: Recently built a digital twin as part of Project ReVolve.
hpe.summary: Models the 8-station flow in real time, surfaces bottlenecks as they form, and lets managers test changes in simulation first.
